opening: Peak Northeast summer, so the week is built on the three things at their best right now: zucchini and spinach in a frittata, sweet corn charred with poblanos in a cold bean salad, and a red curry that leans on green beans. The three stay clear of each other on every axis — eggs, then pinto beans, then tofu; a bagel, then the corn itself, then brown rice; Italian, then Mexican, then Thai. Protein lands at 146g a day against a 140g target, but fibre from the three recipes is about 24g — the frittata is a low-fibre breakfast by nature, and it takes the standing wholewheat bagel and banana to clear 30g.
